versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-kuaishou-data-extractor.  
- Provides structured JSON data for Kuaishou: search videos by keyword, fetch creator posts, and retrieve video comments.
- No login required; supports up to 10,000 records per task with batch operations.
- Designed for use in Kuaishou data analysis, competitor research, trend insight, and KOL/content monitoring.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for operation; see https://www.guaikei.com for setup.
- Includes clear capability boundaries, input requirements, usage rules, and error handling guidelines.
